definitions.explanation: A color between yellow and green, like the color of new leaves in spring or a lime. One of the traditional Japanese color names and one of the standard crayon colors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新芽|しんめ}→新芽：13028_shinme⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黄緑|きみどり}{色|いろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{黄緑|きみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧クレヨン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{葉|は}っぱ→葉っぱ：05388_happa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I colored the leaves with a yellow-green crayon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{黄緑|きみどり}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧いく。
examples.english: When spring comes, the mountains gradually change from yellow-green to deep green.

notes:
{黄緑|きみどり} is a standard Japanese color name for the color between yellow and green, like new spring leaves or a lime.

FORMS:
⟦{黄|き}→黄：19352_ki⟧ (yellow) + ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧ (green).
- {黄緑|きみどり}: as a noun (the color itself)
- {黄緑|きみどり}{色|いろ}: as a modifier (yellow-green colored)
- {黄緑|きみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: modifying a noun

USAGE:
- Art supplies: クレヨンや⟦{色|いろ}{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→色鉛筆：28370_iroenpitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黄緑|きみどり} (yellow-green crayon/colored pencil)
- Nature: ⟦{新芽|しんめ}→新芽：13028_shinme⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黄緑|きみどり} (the yellow-green of new buds)
- Clothing and design

RELATED COLORS:
- ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧: green
- ⟦{黄色|きいろ}→黄色：02870_kiiro⟧: yellow
- {若草色|わかくさいろ}: young grass green (a traditional, more poetic name for a similar shade)
- {萌黄|もえぎ}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: another traditional name for yellowish-green
